high_level_description: The image is a collage of two photographs featuring a helicopter and a person waving. Top Photograph: The top photograph shows a white helicopter in mid-flight, appearing to be taking off or landing on a grassy field. The helicopter has a sleek design with a green underside and red accents near the tail and along the fuselage. Inside the helicopter, there are at least two individuals visible through the windows. One person is seated in the front, wearing a white cap, and appears to be waving or gesturing with their hand.
